description: Graph mail paging through the GET-only reader: the allowlisted ingestion inbox read with page_size=1, max_pages=3 over a 730-day window must follow at least one @odata.nextLink (OData key form) without error; counts only.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it. Expected over the 730-day window: pages 3, items_read 3, reasons exactly [cap:page_cap] (json_equals on every reason). Any other reason fails the check, including source_error:SourceUnavailable:nextlink_escaped on the second continuation after one accepted nextLink (partial counts pages 2, items_read 2 are kept and would otherwise satisfy json_min). A read that ends with no reason (fewer than four messages in the initial window, so page 3 carries no nextLink and the read is complete) fails too, as missing reasons: a data condition, not a paging defect; widen initial_window_days then (done: live-2026-10-20T22:59:46Z, results/latest.json, read pages 3, items_read 2 and no reason over 90 days because the inbox held two messages in that window, a data condition; the window is now 730 days; whether the inbox holds four or more messages in 730 days is unverified live, and with fewer the check stays red with missing reasons). Mail completeness is by received time only. Completeness: this probe claims paging, not a whole capture. A read to its page cap ends incomplete by design with reason cap:page_cap, so the spec has no complete_when: one that demanded state complete failed every run whose expectations all held (live-2026-10-21T05:10:11Z: pages 3, items_read 3, reasons [cap:page_cap], leaked 0). The bars that judge paging (pages, items_read, the cap reason, leaked) are unchanged (verify/tests/test_mail_paging_spec.py). Blocked: with PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS unset or invalid the people guard refuses the mailbox before any request for it (fail closed); the unit ends incomplete with reason blocked:people_exclusion:<code> and the run report carries a top-level blocked_upstream part (part the unit id, source people-exclusion, error_code the guard's code, cause later_ask, later_ask excluded-people-oids). A guard whose directory listing failed or was truncated (the ids set, /users refused, 5xx or cut) is no typed block: the unit's reason is that failure (source_error:...), so the check fails. expect then fails on the missing cap reason and expect_blocked applies: the check reads blocked, never pass, and still fails on a leaked row, an interrupted run or a second unit. expect_blocked asks for no positive minimum, so a blocked run is not measured: paging is unverified until the list is set.
